ThingDef.label: Wraith Dart
ThingDef.description: A Wraith culling and interceptor craft. Its Stargate-specific culling beam can dematerialize exact biological captives into the shuttle's native transport buffer, while boarding and launch remain governed by RimWorld's shuttle systems.

li.notHackedInspectString: Wraith flight and culling controls are secured.
li.hackedInspectString: Wraith controls breached; shuttle transferred to colony control.
li.hackedMessage: {HACKER} has breached the Wraith Dart controls, released any buffered captives and transferred the surviving shuttle to colony control.

ThingDef.label: Wraith strike craft
ThingDef.description: A heavier Wraith combat shuttle derived from Wraith fighter and support-craft technology. It preserves native shuttle boarding and transport behavior.

ThingDef.label: Wraith cruiser shuttle
ThingDef.description: A large Wraith transport and assault craft represented at RimWorld shuttle scale. It remains a native boardable shuttle; larger strategic Wraith cruisers and hive ships are separate world-scale craft.

ThingDef.label: Puddle Jumper
ThingDef.description: An Ancient/Lantean gate-capable shuttle. Native RimWorld/Odyssey shuttle systems own boarding, loading and launch; WNG adds Ancient control and drone-weapon behavior around that native foundation.
